name: Los Padres National Forest
policyReason: Dogs are welcome; 6-ft leash on trails and in campgrounds.
summary: Dogs are welcome; 6-ft leash on trails and in campgrounds.

excerpts.quote: Dogs are always welcome on the Los Padres National Forest.
While on a trail or in and around campgrounds and picnic areas, dogs must be kept on a leash (unless caged or crated) no longer than six feet.
